name: BetterBuys

sources.title: BetterBuys About — repositioned as a B2B AI-discovery portal; published scoring formula (35% category fit, 20% use-case, 15% buyer/industry, 10% integration, 10% evidence, 5% pricing transparency, 5% freshness); sponsored placements labeled and never affect ranking (content read via search result; site 403 to fetchers)
Homepage — 'Building an AI solution? Get found by buyers… contact@betterbuys.com' (content read via search result)

requirements: AI products for business only — BetterBuys is now a B2B AI-tool discovery portal, no longer general business-software reviews
Listing route is email: contact@betterbuys.com ('Get your AI listed where buyers are comparing tools')
Products are scored on a published formula — expect them to evaluate category fit, use-case fit, integrations, evidence quality, pricing transparency
Sponsored placements exist but are labeled and don't affect organic ranking
betterbuys.com blocked automated fetch (403) — verified via About and homepage snippets
preparation: An AI product aimed at business buyers with clear use cases and transparent pricing
Listing details ready: category, use cases, integrations, evidence (case studies), pricing
workflow: Email contact@betterbuys.com with the product and its business use cases
If accepted, the product gets a scored product page in the AI-discovery portal
Optional: labeled sponsored placement (doesn't change ranking)
watchFor: Repositioned product — the old business-software review coverage is gone; AI-only now
Traffic is modest (third-party data suggests ~1k monthly visits) — small upside
Site blocked automated fetch — verify current state in a real browser
Public scoring formula means product pages are re-evaluated; stale pages show 'last verified' dates
countsAsLive: The product has a scored page in the BetterBuys AI directory
unknowns: Listing turnaround and criteria beyond the scoring rubric
Whether the 'contact@' listing route charges a fee
